_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS) Endurance Test Failure Reports
summary: The Endurance Test Failure Reports document failures of Endurance Tests performed on EMCS and are used as an in-process review of the endurance testing on EMCS.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Endurance Test Failure Reports document failures of Endurance Tests performed on EMCS.
3.2 The Endurance Test Failure Reports will be used as an in-process review of the endurance testing on EMCS.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the Endurance Test Failure Reports required by paragraphs 5.3 and 5.4 of MIL-STD-2203A.
7.2 This DID is related to DI-ATTS-80363A, Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS) Performance Verification and Endurance Test Plans; DI-ATTS-80364A, Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS) Performance Verification and Endurance Test Procedures; and DI-ATTS-80365A, Performance Verification and Endurance Test Reports.
7.3 This DID supersedes DI-ATTS-80366.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Endurance Test Failure Reports shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Endurance Test Failure Reports shall explain in detail the nature and cause of each failure, and corrective action taken.
